title: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
lede: Claude Trading Skills is a set of Claude skills for part-time investors that structures market review, risk checks, trade planning and journaling, rather than handing buy or sell calls to AI.

points: Built around a core of long-term ETF and dividend holdings, with swing trades added only when conditions allow.
Workflow manifests chain skills into routines such as a 15-minute daily market check or a monthly performance review.
A five-skill starter path works from public CSVs and local files with no paid data API.
Skills span breadth and regime analysis, screeners, position sizing, backtesting and a trade journal.
Runs in Claude Code by copying skill folders, or in the Claude web app as uploaded .skill packages.

points.text: A shared data contract recording where market data came from, plus a bias checklist for strategy research.
Free-tier claims are out of date: several skills hit 402 or 403 errors on a new FMP Basic key.
Manually recorded trades in signal-postmortem can save a zero entry price and the wrong verdict.
Contract tests and scheduled live checks for the market-data providers.
